changes.summary: Publish the reusable Solid chat UI as @iota-uz/sdk/chat-ui with native icons, host-owned overlays, managed streams and scoped HTTP cancellation. Granite Ali becomes a consumer of this package rather than maintaining a private chat framework.
scaffold form: the CRUD form's Delete button opens a confirmation dialog that now exists, so records can be deleted from their form again; before, the click dispatched an event nothing listened for.
scaffold form: a refused CRUD save now shows the validation messages it was refused for (the entity error, then each field's), instead of only "Field validation failed".

Delete the legacy Lens rendering stack: pkg/lens/render/react (templ custom-element renderer), the DrillTree/DrillHierarchy client-drill machinery and drill_tree.md, and the React surface of the client-host package. The SolidJS runtime is the only Lens renderer; @iota-uz/sdk client-host no longer carries React peer dependencies. Breaking for any consumer still importing the removed React entrypoints.
Introduce permanent Lens report definitions, independent placements, explicit host draft saves, and preserved compound grid layout.

Rewrite the Lens UI (dashboard/panels, controls, explore/drill, overlays, chart bindings) from React to Solid. Breaking change for React Lens consumers: the React public Lens component API is replaced by Solid and React/ReactDOM are no longer required for the production Lens bundle; React does not remain a second permanent client renderer. Migration guide ships with the release; new Lens capabilities (#1056-#1061) land on Solid.

Restore Lens width, independent SVG instances, typography, initial deep-link state, modal focus and tooltip positioning; fix chat placeholder/fixture CSS, Solid templ imports and matching Chromium CI installation.
Replace the static documentation React/Next/Nextra build with Astro and Solid MDX, retaining public routes, search and diagrams.
Remove the deprecated Go React route renderer; client routes require explicit access and stable Solid feature identity.

crud: SelectField.SetValueType (AsUUIDSelect, AsIntSelect, AsBoolSelect, AsStringSelect) now keeps the field's localization key, sortable, virtual and renderer settings instead of dropping them when it rebuilds the base field.
Restore the React documentation visual vocabulary in static Astro/Solid output, including navigation, Markdown typography, code blocks and native keyboard-accessible menus.
Preserve React-era Lens small radii, temporal controls and table alignment, and Granite chat prompt badge appearance in the Solid runtime.
